PA194AX11Q6. States a new 194-state composition and claims neither a machine below 194 nor a lower bound.
PA194P5. States a 194-state machine that moves five registers and seven router targets of the primary PA194, a PA proof that it halts exactly when PA194 does, and nothing below 194.
PA1944L. States a new 194-state machine with a new decoder, a comparison of 72 deliveries, and neither a machine below 194 nor an unconditional iPRA theorem.
PA194AX11H. States a new 194-state machine composing the AX11 axiom operation with the H halt protocol, nothing below 194, and that the unconditional iPRA theorem is not claimed.
PA194AX11QH. States a new 194-state machine and an analysis of the weak-arithmetic proof obligations, and establishes neither a machine below 194 nor the iPRA equivalence.
PA194AX11S. States a different 194-state composition with a relative iPRA source-equivalence proof, and establishes neither a machine below 194 nor the absolute iPRA theorem.
Comparison and two new 194-state implementations. States a command-level weak-arithmetic proof, an obstruction for one 193-state bootstrap family, and nothing below 194.
PA194AX11H and PA194QAX11H. States two new 194-state machines, a written proof of the iPRA equivalence for each, and that no machine below 194 was obtained.
PA194AX11QH4L and PA194AX11QH4R. States two new 194-state machines for the PA194AX11QH source program with a relative iPRA proof, and nothing below 194.
PA194GH and PA194GHS. States two new 194-state physical designs and that no construction below 194 was obtained.

PA194AX11G. States a new 194-state machine combining the generalization binder of PA194G with the AX11 protocol, a relative proof that it halts exactly when the primary PA194 does, and nothing below 194.
Frontier audit and PA194AX11G, PA194GH. States two new 194-state machines with command-level refutation-search proofs and a comparison with 94 recognized 194-state graphs.

PA194AX11GH and PA194AX11GHS with accelerated implementations. States two new 194-state source designs, an exact accelerated implementation of each (four tables), a written proof that depends on an inherited calibration, and nothing below 194.

PA194AX11GH and PA194AX11GHS. States two new 194-state machines combining the eleven-entry AX protocol with a generalization binder, a relative iPRA proof that each halts exactly when QAX11H does, and nothing below 194.

PA194LC_AX11H, PA194LC, PA194LC_A, PA194LC_B and PA194LC_C. States five new 194-state machines obtained by a three-row loop-continuation patch, a relative iPRA proof for each, a written iPRA equivalence with Con(PA) for PA194LC_AX11H that imports the AX11H calibration, and nothing below 194.

PA194AX11QGH and PA194AX11HR. States two new 194-state tables, a written proof of the iPRA equivalence for each that uses the AX11H and QAX11H calibration, that this is not a completed Lean theorem, and nothing below 194.
PA194SEL and PA194AX11GH. States two new 194-state machines, a written iPRA proof that PA194SEL halts exactly when the primary PA194 does, and nothing below 194.

PA194AX11GH and PA194AX11GHS. States two new 194-state machines with a written proof of the iPRA equivalence that uses the AX11H calibration, that this is not a completed Lean or Rocq formalization, and nothing below 194.
Two selector/acceleration compositions: PA194AX11H_SF and PA194LC_AX11H_SF. Direct relative iPRA clock bound 3t; inherited revised AX11H absolute calibration.
Three source compositions PA194GD/GDH/GDHS, with independent explicit generalizer binder c and diagonal operand D=d+x. Written iPRA calibration inherited through AX11H.
PA194LCAX11GHF and PA194LCAX11GHSF combine loop continuations with two guarded shortcuts. Relative iPRA proof. Tagged-three alternate calculus has a 207-state implementation, not a sub-194 result.
PA194LCG and PA194LCGS add a third guarded return shortcut to loop/AX11GH/GHS compositions. Relative iPRA clock envelope and inherited revised AX11H calibration.
Four AX11GDH realizations combine independent binder/diagonal parameters with the eleven-entry AX interface; symmetric, fast and helper-separated companions.
PA194LCGMS/LCGSMS separate marker history on the LCG/LCGS loop-return parents; direct relative iPRA clocks and inherited absolute calibration.
PA194H5X/JH5X change the witness consequent and optionally the first axiom head; uniform syntactic translations and inherited revised AX11H calibration.
